security.csp: default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data: https://ddragon.leagueoflegends.com; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self' data:; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; frame-ancestors 'self'

bundle.shortDescription: Surface champ-select teammates, auto-accept queue pops, and dodge in one click
bundle.longDescription: Expose is a lightweight tray companion for the League of Legends client. It surfaces the summoner names of your teammates during ranked champion select, can auto-accept queue ready checks, and offers a one-click dodge.
